manufacturer: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology (hongjiacheng); design.py leaves manufacturer blank
notes: Datasheet has no pin numbers: polarity only by the cathode line. KiCad D_SOD-323 pad 1 is the cathode (silkscreen closes at the pad-1 end, x = -1.61) and Device:D_Schottky pin 1 = K, pin 2 = A, so pad 1 = cathode is consistent.

Land pattern: the datasheet suggests about 0.70 x 0.70 mm pads (X/Y 0.65-0.75) with a 2.10-2.20 mm overall span (Z); KiCad's pads are 0.60 x 0.45 mm with a 2.70 mm span. This is a footprint-geometry difference, not a pin-numbering one.

ratings.design: D3: PWR_EN (<= ~4.2 V on cell) vs VBUS_EN 0 V; D6: LS_GATE vs VBUS ~0 V

ratings.limit: 240 mV at 0.1 mA, 320 mV at 1 mA (max)
